front_segments.limit: Straight-segment approximation, strict unknown/infinite and present-phase refusal; not every legacy packet supported

intensity_and_wind.limit: Fuel-specific empirical laws and declared cap, no local physical fit

flux_at_points.limit: Two-boundary panel model, not volumetric flame or exact bilinear isochrone

spatial_time_enclosure.limit: Zero lower bound and global candidate-panel count upper are generally too loose for route acceptance

physical_comparisons.limit: Prompt mixes shrub/flame heights, absent instantaneous front widths, in-flame irradiance and emitter power

factor_three_gate.limit: No comparable empirical threefold-error assessment can be asserted; diagnostics are not measured validation errors

cutoff_error.limit: No default radius truncation; no uniform relative tail-error claim

extinction_and_present_state.limit: Per-cell finite expiry supported, scalar max-remaining old-fire phases cannot identify a front

dose.limit: Piecewise-linear flux assumption, not continuous-route integration bounds

provenance.limit: Unlocated clinical thresholds omitted, not silently adopted

frozen_adapter_copy.limit: No complete v2 checker, gate raises NotImplementedError

five_policy_20_mission_ablation.limit: Physics gate unresolved; no changed thresholds or invented outcomes

binding_peak_position_maps.limit: Cannot generate journey binding maps from unexecuted studies

journey_cost_abba_two_repetitions.limit: No v2 complete checker performance claim
